title: SystemInfo
description: This type represents an information provided by the MEC orchestrator as a part of the "Registration of MEC system to the federation"

systemId.description: Identifier of the MEC system. For the uniqueness of the identifier across the federated MEC systems, UUID format [i.9] is recommended. Shall be absent in POST request, and present otherwise.

systemName.description: The name of the MEC system. This is how the MEC system identifies other MEC systems
